name: rbo-monorepo
description: Remote Build Orchestrator for running isolated build, test, QEMU, and Docker jobs on local or remote workers.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter "@rbo/shared" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/protocol" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/snapshot" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/executor" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/testing" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/controller" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/agent" build && pnpm --filter "@gemslibe/rbo" build && pnpm --filter "@rbo/mcp-stdio" build
scripts.rust:verify: cargo fmt --manifest-path native/windows-executor/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo test --manifest-path native/windows-executor/Cargo.toml
scripts.verify: pnpm run lint && pnpm run test && pnpm run rust:verify
